name: P-023 live pilot re-measure on the current standing-PR code (after the WI-10006271 fork-match change)
command: The probe (sha256 4c41acfd05a6bc29bed39ed9c804e4ad30e07ecfbc75361467c9dc08e0665868) builds the current tree's GitHubPrHost over a gh-auth Octokit, lists Papercusp/pot-review-pilot PRs (open and all), runs the current findStandingPr with forkRepo=githubRepoOf('https://github.com/papercupai/pot-review-pilot.git') and baseBranch 'main', repeats it with forkRepo 'someone-else/pot-review-pilot' as a negative control, reads getPrDetails for the adopted and the merged PRs, and reads the main branch of both repos with gh api. Read-only: nothing is opened, pushed or edited.
summary: Live GitHub, current code: the standing-PR selector adopts the existing open PR #2 (head papercupai/pot-review-pilot:papercusp/working-copy) instead of opening a duplicate; the same listing with a foreign fork adopts nothing. PR #2 lists exactly one commit (f65af00), none of merged PR #1's five commits; its base is upstream main fd96063 (the merged main) and its head equals the fork's green-promoted main f65af00. Replaces binding 25874, whose measured sources moved with the fork-match change.

assertions.evidence: findStandingPr(open PRs, { baseBranch:'main', forkRepo:'papercupai/pot-review-pilot' }) returned PR #2; the adapter reported head_repo 'papercupai/pot-review-pilot'
PR #2 commits = [f65af003275678071ceb75fc5b6491a4a9c9059f]; overlap with merged PR #1's 5 commits = []

observations.runtime: GitHub repos Papercusp/pot-review-pilot (upstream) and papercupai/pot-review-pilot (working-copy fork)

companionTest.note: real-git integration run after the head_repo fixture update

notMeasured: No new promotion was pushed to the pilot during this re-measure; it observes the existing PR #2 and the current selector's choice over the live listing.
The >=2-agents-inside-the-pilot-pot clause is not observed live; per plan decision D-016 the D-006 real-git test covers it.
